auto_naming_hint: By default, fixes only clearly unusable names, once per session. Uses your information sorting model. Names you set yourself are never replaced.
auto_naming_max_hint: Total successful automatic name changes per session, including scheduled updates. Enter 1–1000.
auto_naming_periodic_hint: Off by default. Only updates after new output, and counts toward the same maximum. Turning this on starts with 24 hours.
auto_naming_interval_hint: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8760.
auto_naming_raise_max: Raise the maximum above 1 to allow recurring name updates.
auto_naming_save_failed: Couldn't confirm the naming settings. The last confirmed values are shown. Check the connection and retry.
workspace_hint: Read-only tasks need no new workspace. Busy directories get an isolated checkout. Each plan can override this.
workspace_unconfirmed: The assistant did not confirm the workspace preference. Please retry.
subtitle: Your personal assistant
proactive_footer: Starts work on schedule, follows up on what it promised, and notifies your phone when done. Say "brief me every day at 9" or "remind me in an hour" in a chat to add one here.
notifications_footer: When on, tasks sent from the main chat don't get their own notifications, Dynamic Island, or badge. Persona tells you in the main chat when they finish, need an answer, or fail. Only affects tasks sent from now on.
quiet_tasks: Notify main chat tasks in the main chat only
start_requested: Start what I asked for in the chat right away
trust_intro: Remembered rules can start matching tasks directly. To remember a rule again, choose “Start these right away from now on” on a matching plan.
trust_unresolved: The computer and directory could not be separated for this rule.
trust_dismiss_explanation: Dismissing this warning does not confirm removal. If the assistant returns the rule later, it will appear again.
trust_confirm_body: Remove the remembered auto-start rule for this task kind?
trust_scope: Other settings may still start tasks automatically. A matching plan can be remembered again.
trust_read_forbidden: You don't have access to view these rules (HTTP 403).
trust_read_not_found: The assistant couldn't load these rules (HTTP 404).
trust_read_unavailable: The assistant couldn't load these rules right now. Please retry.
trust_read_error: Couldn't load the remembered rules. Please retry.
trust_revoke_forbidden: Full access is required to remove this rule. You can retry it here.
trust_revoke_not_found: The rule or removal endpoint was not found. Removal could not be confirmed; refresh or retry.
trust_revoke_unavailable: The assistant couldn't remove this rule right now. Removal is unconfirmed; retry.
trust_revoke_unconfirmed: Removal could not be confirmed. The rule may still apply; retry.
start_footer: When on, what you ask Persona to do in the chat starts at once and the plan card only shows progress; tasks Persona comes up with itself still wait for Start. Read-only tasks and kinds you chose to start without asking always start at once.
knows_footer: About me is what you tell Persona. Memory is what it noted on its own in chats. You can edit both.
memory_empty: No memory yet. Persona keeps your preferences and the things you've corrected here.
index_hint: MEMORY.md: the table of contents Persona keeps, updated when a memory is deleted. Read-only
runs_on_footer: Each chat runs in the background in this directory on {machine}, outside herdr. Transcripts and memory stay on that machine; About me, scheduled tasks, and settings live on the hub. Pick the model under Model settings › Main chat.
about_saved: About me saved. Applies to new chats
about_placeholder: For example: where your code lives, skills you use, machines or folders to leave alone, how you like updates
about_note: This is added to the end of Persona's instructions. Changes apply to new chats.
about_note_hub: It's using the assistant's config for now; once you save here, this takes over.
runs_on_none: No computer chosen to run on yet. Once a computer is connected, conversations run in the background on it.
configuration_target_hint: All settings below belong to this assistant. Switching keeps other assistants unchanged.
configuration_target_missing: This assistant is no longer available. Select another assistant.
default_permissions_hint: Applies only to new non-guest sessions without an explicit permission choice. Existing sessions keep their mode. Runtime policy may be limited by the platform.
default_permissions_unconfirmed: The assistant did not confirm this permission setting. Reload before trying again.
meeting_attendance_footer: Pre-selects Persona's role when a meeting recording starts on the phone; you can change it each time. As a listener it answers on the phone's screen; as a participant it also says the answers aloud. Answers use only this meeting’s title, calendar hint, live lines and earlier questions and answers. Earlier meetings are not included.
meeting_attendance_unconfirmed: The assistant did not confirm this meeting setting. Reload before trying again.
recordings_footer: Recordings older than this leave the knowledge base, and the phone deletes its own copies, audio included. Meeting minutes are kept forever by default, until you delete them. You can choose a number of days after the meeting instead, never fewer than the recording’s.
recordings_footer_with_minutes: Recordings older than this leave the knowledge base together with their meeting minutes, and the phone deletes its own copies, audio included.
retention_unconfirmed: The assistant did not confirm this retention. Reload before trying again.
agent_tasks: Follow up every agent Persona starts
agent_tasks_hint: Agents started outside the main chat also get a quiet task with a supervisor, which checks the result and closes them when done. Uses extra model calls
inbox_signals_hint: When the Inbox's AI twin links a new message from someone else to a task Persona follows up, the conversation supervising that task hears of it in its next supervision message. Needs the AI twin. Uses extra model calls
archive_closed_hint: A closed session with no open task leaves the lists after this many idle days and stays under Archived. 0 turns it off
background_folded_footer: Rounds that another conversation, a scheduled task or a follow-up started in the main chat or a leader conversation show as one line you can open. Rounds that ask or tell you something stay shown.
next_suggestions_footer: After a reply in a chat you have open, a small model suggests what you might send next, above the empty message box. Claude Code in a terminal keeps its own suggestions. Uses one extra model call per reply; the model is set under Model configuration › Next-message suggestions.
idle_close_hint: Their terminal stays. 0 turns it off.
main_supervises: The main chat supervises its own tasks
main_supervises_hint: Off by default: a built-in background supervisor follows up and reviews the tasks Persona hands out, so the main chat stays free to answer you; turn this on and the main chat does that itself, as it did before
